author: (Say, 1822)

note.en: A thin, glossy little clam of about 1.25 cm that lives in sand and mud, including estuaries. Two museum specimens come from 12 m, one from the Gandoca to Sixaola stretch and one off Cahuita.
note.es: Una almejita delgada y brillante de unos 1,25 cm que vive en arena y fango, incluso en estuarios. Dos ejemplares de museo vienen de 12 m, uno del tramo de Gandoca a la desembocadura del Sixaola y otro frente a Cahuita.

evidence: GBIF: 2 preserved specimen(s) in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001 and 2003)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection and other museum records), Gandoca to Limón
